name: Iiyama (Japan)
description: A green field charged at the centre with the Iiyama city emblem in white: a ring open at the top enclosing a stylised letter W.
history: Municipal flag of Iiyama, a city in Nagano Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The flag was adopted on 1 August 1974; the emblem dates from 1 August 1954.

features.role: Iiyama city emblem — a ring open at the top enclosing a stylised letter W
